primary_public_generate.boundary: public generate(), including first-token device sampling, caller-visible Python token list, and 128 minimal token readbacks

terminal_trials.notes: Persistent BF16 row-major embedding exceeds TP1 capacity; generic BFP8 gather is numerically invalid; DRAM-sharded LM-head splits lose before concat; program-config and softcap candidates are negligible or perturb top-100 ranks.

limitations: P150/P150x2/P150x4 results are proxy profiles on a P300C QB2 and are hardware-specific.
Teacher-forcing throughput is correctness evidence because host feedback and allocation tracking perturb its latency.
The logits-only and token-out component traces were captured separately, so their difference is not a matched sampler-overhead measurement.
The reduced profiler contains two representative decoder layers and must not be presented as all-layer latency.
The public compatibility sampling mode reads logits on the host by explicit request; it is not the optimized measured path.
